search_text: 设 $z=z(x,y)$ 由方程 $F(\frac yx,\frac zx)=0$ 确定，$F_2'\ne0$，则 $x z_x+y z_y=(\quad)$。 $z$ $-x$ $x$ $z$ $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{F'_x}{F'_z}=-\frac{F'_1(-\frac{y}{x^2})+F'_2(-\frac{z}{x^2})}{F'_2\frac{1}{x}}=\frac{F'_1y+F'_2z}{xF'_2}$，$$\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-\frac{F'_y}{F'_z}=-\frac{F'_1\frac{1}{x}}{F'_2\frac{1}{x}}=-\frac{F'_1}{F'_2}$$，则 $x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=x\frac{F'_1y+F'_2z}{xF'_2}+y(-\frac{F'_1}{F'_2})=z$
